entities.name: Silas Renn
entities.description: A human of Esper, heir of the House of Renn, member of the Seekers of Carmot and enemy of Tezzeret.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: Planeswalker who joined the Seekers, rose in Bolas's Infinite Consortium, then massacred the Seekers.

entities.name: Seekers of Carmot
entities.description: Sect of Esper that Tezzeret later massacred.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Elder Dragon who inducted Tezzeret and later killed Renn's body.

entities.name: Infinite Consortium
entities.description: Bolas's covert organization, taken over by Tezzeret.

entities.name: Esper
entities.description: Shard of Alara where Renn was born.

entities.name: Sanctum Arcanum
entities.description: The Seekers' Sanctum, taken over by Tezzeret.

entities.name: Crystal Labyrinth
entities.description: Place where Renn blocked Tezzeret's path.

entities.name: Kemuel
entities.description: Person Tezzeret sought in the Crystal Labyrinth.

entities.name: Test of Metal
entities.description: Fever dream sequence in which Tezzeret returns to the Sanctum.

events.summary: Tezzeret repeatedly duels Silas Renn at the Academy and loses, deemed unworthy of the Seekers.
Silas is granted the first etherium heart for becoming the youngest adept.
events.quote: Silas was later granted the first ever created Etherium heart for becoming the youngest adept among the Seekers.

events.summary: Tezzeret murders the entire sect of the Seekers; Silas survives by being absent.
events.quote: he murdered the entire sect, eliminating the new Hieresiarch and the whole Arcane Council

events.summary: Silas blocks Tezzeret's path with zombies and fights him; Tezzeret slices him in two.
events.quote: Tezzeret managed to gain the upper hand by opening a portal, slicing Renn in two parts

events.summary: Bolas strips the body of etherium on Metal Island and kills Silas, all within Tezzeret's fever dream.
events.quote: then brought to Metal Island where Bolas killed him

relations.quote: He was also a member of the Seekers of Carmot
being inducted into the Elder Dragon 's covert organization, the Infinite Consortium
then brought to Metal Island where Bolas killed him
